review.images: Reviewed eight official gallery frames and the wide hero. Kept eight distinct developer renders after omitting the narrower repeated hero scene. The listing image shows the development, and living and bedroom views are used in the editorial panels.
review.location: Matched the exact project point and verified the project brochure’s regional Emaar South map and four driving estimates on physical page 4. The wider map and exact property point remain distinct.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all 18 physical pages and kept every residence drawing. Cross-checked the imperial area panels visually, against independent PDFium and spatial extraction, and against arithmetic. The 17 sheets cover 13 apartment and four townhouse drawings, with 19 area panels. The current official property page links the brochure. The complete Emaar-branded plan pack came from the DXB Off Plan broker mirror and is credited accordingly.

unavailable: A developer-hosted copy of the same complete floor-plan pack was not verified.
Signed unit-specific areas and entrance coordinates were not verified.
